WITH equipment_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    equipref,
    AVG(humepct) as equip_avg_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY equipref
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(equip_avg_humidity) as overall_avg_humidity
  FROM equipment_avgs
),
kept_equipment AS (
  SELECT 
    ea.equipref,
    ea.equip_avg_humidity
  FROM equipment_avgs ea,
       overall_avg oa
  WHERE oa.overall_avg_humidity IS NOT NULL
    AND ea.equip_avg_humidity > oa.overall_avg_humidity
),
kept_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(equip_avg_humidity) as kept_equipment_mean
  FROM kept_equipment
)
SELECT
  ke.equipref,
  ke.equip_avg_humidity,
  ke.equip_avg_humidity - oa.overall_avg_humidity as exceeds_overall_avg,
  ABS(ke.equip_avg_humidity - km.kept_equipment_mean) as diff_from_kept_mean
FROM kept_equipment ke,
     overall_avg oa,
     kept_mean km
WHERE km.kept_equipment_mean IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC
LIMIT 10
